desc: Name the missing primitive. In copy_highpage, immediately before copy_page(), try ONE change per build and run scripts/t6040-cow-repro.sh 4x at maxcpus=2 after each: (a) smp_mb() only; (b) a single volatile read of kto only; (c) a single volatile read of kfrom only; (d) flush_dcache_page(to) / __flush_dcache_area equivalent on the destination; (e) nothing (control, = 208). The cheapest variant that makes the fault vanish names what the CoW path is missing on this hardware. If (a) suffices it is an ordering bug; if only (d) suffices it is cache maintenance; if only the full virt_addr_valid() work suffices it is a timing artefact and the real bug is elsewhere. Depends on 208 passing. This is the ticket most likely to produce an upstreamable patch. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-03: 208 passed, so the suppression is real. Follow 208s method rule: fresh-boot baseline + >=4 runs per variant, run 1 is the sensitive one.
